Lardil concepts of burdal ‘song’, laka ‘way’ and mirndiyan ‘dreaming’ are explored, and song practices of recent times considered in terms of cultural shift and commercialisation of song culture. Are Lardil songs lost? The Lardil song tradition known as burdal has never really been lost. However, its history is not necessarily an unbroken linear narrative.
